checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.
and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

wikipediaActualRead.title: Ashteroth Karnaim
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: アシュタロテ節では、ヨシュア記12:4・13:31などのアシュタロテをこの名で記す。本文はアシュタロテとカルナイムをめぐる遺跡比定の不確実性も述べるため、テル・アシュタラを確定地と扱わない。
wikipediaActualRead.actualPageExcerptJa: 記事のBiblical references節はJoshua 12:4で名が単にAshtarothと記されること、Identification節はAshtaroth候補をTell Ashtaraとしつつ不確実性を述べる。

geographyAssessmentJa: 本文はオグの町として場所を特定するため、既存候補点は「アシュタロテ（比定不確実）」の候補として保持可能。テル・アシュタラへの同定はWikipediaでも議論あり、位置確定や現代都市ピンと誤表示しない。
